notes: Event date: 7 February 1945 (Last Offensive ch. 6 p. 101-103: General Eddy's XII Corps assaulted the Sauer on the night of 6 February; the attached regimental combat team of the 76th Division, the 417th Infantry, protected the right flank of the 5th Division; Companies A and B formed the assault wave at Echternach).
